title: Ecological properties uniquely dictate molecular-level soil organic matter composition in a temperate forest in Central Europe with variation in litter deposition
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,763-778
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00462K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Isla Wrightson, Maryam Tabatabaei Anaraki, István Fekete, Zsolt Kotroczó, Kate Lajtha, Myrna J. Simpson
An integrative analytical approach was used to assess the unique molecular-level soil organic matter (SOM) responses to detrital manipulation, which were dictated by the ecological properties of a temperate forest in Central Europe.
